GHA.note: Nothing on rules or authority against AI harms.
Tools are for agriculture and health, not general administration.

facts.fact: CSIR-INSTI rolled out AI-driven maize and tomato leaf disease detection apps and a microscope-based malaria detection app, said to be available for public use.
facts.system: Maize Leaf Disease Detection App, Tomato Leaf Disease Detection App, Malaria Detection App

facts.fact: CSIR-INSTI, a Ghanaian public research institute, designed and rolled out AI-driven crop disease detection and malaria detection apps, which its director said can be downloaded by the public.
facts.system: Maize Leaf Disease Detection App, Tomato Leaf Disease Detection App, Malaria Detection App
